sentences.text: Shri Akhil Godha, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri Sudhanshu Vyas, learned Panel Lawyer for the respo Heard on the question of admission.
Admit.
Also heard on I.A. No.12792/2022, an application under Section 397 of Cr.P.C for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant.

T he applicant has been convicted for offence under Section 7(1) read with Section 16(1)(A)(i) and Section 14-A read with Section 16(1-C) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo 6 months S.I., 3 months S.I. with fine of Rs.1000/-, Rs.500/- with default stipulation.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present crime.
He further submits that the learned Courts below have not followed Rule 14 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules, 1955, which is mandatory and has convicted the accused/applicant.
He has drawn attention of this Court to paragraph 3 of the impugned judgment in this regard.
There are fair chances of success of this revision petition and there is no likelihood of early hearing of this petition in near future.
If the remaining custodial sentence of the applicant is not suspended, then revision filed by him may turn infructuous.
Under these circumstances, looking to the short sentence, counsel prays for suspension of remaining jail sentence and grant of bail to the applicant.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and short sentence involved in the matter and the fact that petition is likely to take time for final hearing, this Court is of the considered opinion that the application for suspension of custodial sentence filed on behalf of the applicant deserves to be allowed.

sentences.text: Accordingly, I.A. No.12792/2022 is allowed and it is directed that upon furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court, for his regular appearance before this Court, the execution of jail sentence imposed against the applicant shall remain suspended, till the final disposal of this petition.
The applicant after being enlarged on bail, shall mark his presence before the Registry of this Court on 14/12/2022 and on all such subsequent dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard.
List for final hearing in due course.
I.A.No.12792/2022 stands allowed and disposed off.

(RAJENDRA KUMAR (VERMA)) JUDGE RJ Santosh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22 September, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62980474/
